brief: Opportunities are heavily concentrated in Brooklyn market-tier parcels where combining the 485-x tax exemption with Section 8 VPS rents delivers strong returns, reaching up to 31.8% CoC. Out of 1,271 scanned and 921 qualified lots, top-scoring deals are predominantly city-owned sites across Brooklyn R6, R7A, and R7-2 zones. A secondary cluster in the Bronx offers all-affordable program plays generating developer fees via ELLA / 4% LIHTC stacks, though these rely heavily on competitive subsidy awards.

targets.risk: Requires navigating the city-owned HPD/EDC disposition RFP process alongside zoning and site condition verification.
